chars.DJ: DJ: a Moroccan man around 30 with a short black beard and a fade haircut, wearing a mustard-yellow oversized hoodie, big black headphones around his neck, black joggers, white sneakers
chars.GIRL: GIRL: a young Swedish woman with long platinum-blonde hair and blue eyes, wearing a lilac knit sweater and small silver hoop earrings

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: DJ lounges on a sofa in a modern Casablanca apartment at night, scrolling Instagram on his phone with a curious mischievous grin, the phone glow lighting his face; vertical full-screen 2D cartoon, subject centered, calm background edges, no text

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: DJ sits up on the sofa, eyebrows raised in delighted surprise as he scrolls far-away foreign profiles on his phone, a world map poster on the wall behind him; 2D cartoon, subject centered, no text

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: close-ish shot of DJ typing a message on his phone with both thumbs, tongue out in concentration, confident smirk; 2D cartoon, face visible, no text, no readable screen

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: DJ stands in his living room puffing out his chest proudly, thumb pointing at himself, as if saying he does not just follow and wait like others; comic pose; 2D cartoon, no text

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: DJ presses send on his phone holding it up at arm's length, biting his lip nervously, eyes squeezed half shut; 2D cartoon, face visible, no text

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: DJ behind his DJ booth in a Casablanca club with purple lights, headphones on one ear, staring at his phone waiting for a reply, impatient face, crowd blurred far behind; 2D cartoon, no text

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: DJ lying in bed in the dark at night typing yet another message on his phone with a hopeful smile, phone glow on his face; 2D cartoon, no text

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: GIRL sits on a cozy bed in a bright room with a window, looking at her phone with a puzzled amused smile and raised eyebrow; 2D cartoon, face visible, centered, no text

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: DJ on his sofa, jaw dropped and eyes wide with excitement, hands on his head, phone in his lap, as if he just realised something incredible; comic 2D cartoon, face visible, no text
